metadata.title: Leverandørvakt – early warnings about your suppliers
metadata.description: Follow your suppliers and customers and get notified when something changes for the worse: new roles, annual accounts, bankruptcy and risk signals, from open data in the Brønnøysund Register Centre.

header.colorScheme: Switch between light and dark mode

hero.title: Know when a supplier changes for the worse, before it costs you
hero.lead: Follow your suppliers and customers. Leverandørvakt checks the Brønnøysund registers around the clock and tells you when a CEO leaves, an auditor resigns, accounts are late or a company goes bankrupt.

accounts.text: Equity turned negative in the 2025 accounts

features.title: What Leverandørvakt watches for you
features.lead: Everything is based on official, open data. Every warning says what changed, when and why it matters.

changes.title: Changes in the register
changes.text: New CEO, board or auditor, a new address, bankruptcy or liquidation. Brønnøysund's update feeds are checked every ten minutes.

accounts.title: Annual accounts
accounts.text: New and corrected filings, equity turning negative and audits being dropped, compared year by year.

risk.title: Risk signals you can explain
risk.text: A check before you sign: every signal with its weight and reason, and what could not be checked. Support for your own assessment, not a credit rating.

connections.title: Connections
connections.text: See when the same people or audit firm hold roles across your suppliers and customers, or in a company you are considering.

trends.title: Regional trends
trends.text: New companies per month by municipality and industry, compared with the same period a year earlier.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.text: Ask in plain language, in English or Norwegian: “Which of my suppliers have the highest risk?” It only reads your data, it never changes it.

search.title: Search
search.text: Find a company by name or organization number.

follow.title: Follow
follow.text: Add your suppliers and customers to your watchlist, with a private note for each.

notified.title: Get notified
notified.text: You are notified when something changes, rated as critical, warning or info.

sources.title: Built on open public data
sources.lead: Leverandørvakt reads open data from Norwegian public agencies. Nothing is bought, scraped or guessed.

brreg.name: The Brønnøysund Register Centre
brreg.text: The Central Coordinating Register for Legal Entities, roles, update feeds and the Register of Company Accounts

ssb.name: Statistics Norway
ssb.text: Industry names from the Standard Industrial Classification

cta.title: Start watching your suppliers today
cta.text: Create an account, follow your first company and let Leverandørvakt keep watch.

footer.tagline: Early warnings about your suppliers and customers.
footer.license: Contains data under the Norwegian licence for Open Government data (NLOD) distributed by the Brønnøysund Register Centre, the Norwegian Mapping Authority and Statistics Norway.
footer.independent: Leverandørvakt is an independent project and is not affiliated with these agencies.
